headline: Amie drops 177.96 and puts the league on notice
dek: Opening week brought four winners, one 53-point bench disaster, and Cambri losing with the second-best score in the league.

matchups.2-8: Cambri scored 153.96, the second-best total of the week, and still lost by 24. Amie's Caleb Williams (37.26), Kenneth Walker III (34.1) and Ashton Jeanty (32.7) all roughly doubled their projections.
matchups.4-7: Sam's Ja'Marr Chase scored 3.2 on a 19.9 projection while Stefon Diggs put up 15.5 on her bench. Tara won even with Christian Watson's 32.7 sitting on hers.
matchups.3-6: Kyra won with the sixth-best score of the week. Maddie had 53.68 points on her bench, enough to win this one comfortably.
matchups.1-5: Maya started Davante Adams (5.6) at flex over Bucky Irving (20.3), and her best possible lineup would have won. Marlee benched David Montgomery's 28.9 and still won by 22.36.

game_balls.title: High score of the week
game_balls.text: 177.96 points. Caleb Williams, Kenneth Walker III and Ashton Jeanty combined for 104.06 against a combined projection of 49.04.

game_balls.title: Pickup of the week
game_balls.text: Maya picked up Mark Andrews and dropped him seven hours later. Marlee grabbed him the next day and started him over George Kittle. Andrews scored 8.9, Kittle 3.2.

game_balls.title: Right call at QB
game_balls.text: Started Trevor Lawrence over Dak Prescott. Lawrence scored 26.1, Prescott 14.4. Enjoy it, because the flex decision is further down this page.

flags.title: 53.68 points on the bench
flags.text: The most points left on the bench this week. Chuba Hubbard scored 23.7 on the bench while Jaylen Waddle scored 1.2 at flex. Her best possible lineup scored 148.8, enough to beat Kyra.

flags.title: The flex flop
flags.text: The person who put this recap together benched Bucky Irving (20.3) for Davante Adams (5.6). Her best possible lineup scored 129.8, enough to beat Marlee's 127.66.

flags.title: Montgomery on the bench
flags.text: David Montgomery scored 28.9 on the bench while James Cook III scored 9.9 in the lineup. It didn't matter this time.

flags.title: Watson on the bench
flags.text: Christian Watson scored 32.7 on the bench while Quinshon Judkins scored 7 at flex. She won anyway.

tough_breaks.title: Lost with the second-best score
tough_breaks.text: 153.96 points would have beaten six of the other seven teams. She drew the one that scored 177.96.

tough_breaks.title: Chase disappears
tough_breaks.text: Ja'Marr Chase was projected for 19.9 and scored 3.2, the biggest miss of any starter this week.

tough_breaks.title: A zero at tight end
tough_breaks.text: Colston Loveland scored 0 in her lineup. Amie also got a zero from Kyle Pitts Sr., but she scored 177.96, so she was fine.
